Prepare an extract from the statement of changes in equity for the year ended 31 March 2015
showing the retained earnings column.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Prepare the property, plant and equipment section of the non-current assets note to the
statement of financial position at 31 March 2015.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
Prepare Plantin plc’s statement of financial position at 31 March 2015.
(Comparatives are not required.) 
Additional information
The directors of Plantin plc have recently discovered a material error in the published financial
statements for the year ended 31 March 2014. It was discovered that sales of $30 000, which had
never taken place, had been included in revenue and in trade receivables.
REQUIRED

parts.label: (i)
parts.text: State how this error has affected the financial statements for the year ended 31 March 2014.

parts.label: (ii)
parts.text:
Explain how the directors of Plantin plc should deal with this error in its financial statements
in accordance with IAS8.
